narrative.story: The Luminor Due line, introduced in 2016, is Panerai's thinner, dressier take on the Luminor case for wearers who find the brand's tool-watch proportions too bulky. PAM00927 was one of six references in a 2019 titanium refresh, pairing a blue sunburst dial with the automatic P.900 movement in a 42mm case. Panerai discontinued it in 2020.
narrative.collector_notes: Titanium construction makes this notably lighter than a steel Luminor Marina at a similar diameter; confirm the alligator strap and clasp are original, since third-party straps are common on the secondary market.
